pplant.label: Power plant
pplant.description: A power plant converts an energy source into electricity. The mapped fuel or technology describes the facility; it does not establish the operating status of every unit.

nuclearplant.label: Nuclear power plant
nuclearplant.description: Nuclear fission releases heat. The plant uses that heat to make steam and turn a turbine connected to a generator.

pplant-nuclear.label: Nuclear power plant
pplant-nuclear.description: Nuclear fission releases heat. The plant uses that heat to make steam and turn a turbine connected to a generator.

coalplant.label: Coal power plant
coalplant.description: Burning coal heats water into steam. The steam turns turbines that drive electric generators.

pplant-coal.label: Coal power plant
pplant-coal.description: Burning coal heats water into steam. The steam turns turbines that drive electric generators.

gasplant.label: Gas power plant
gasplant.description: Natural gas supplies heat for an electric generator. Some plants combine a gas turbine with a steam turbine that uses heat from its exhaust.

pplant-gas.label: Gas power plant
pplant-gas.description: Natural gas supplies heat for an electric generator. Some plants combine a gas turbine with a steam turbine that uses heat from its exhaust.

oilplant.label: Oil power plant
oilplant.description: Oil fuels an engine or supplies heat for an electric generator. The mapped fuel label alone does not show how often the unit runs.

pplant-oil.label: Oil power plant
pplant-oil.description: Oil fuels an engine or supplies heat for an electric generator. The mapped fuel label alone does not show how often the unit runs.

hydroplant.label: Hydroelectric plant
hydroplant.description: Moving water turns turbines connected to generators. A dam, channel or drop in elevation supplies the difference in water level that drives the flow.

pplant-hydro.label: Hydroelectric plant
pplant-hydro.description: Moving water turns turbines connected to generators. A dam, channel or drop in elevation supplies the difference in water level that drives the flow.

wasteplant.label: Waste-to-energy plant
wasteplant.description: Burning waste supplies heat to produce steam. That steam can generate electricity or deliver heat to nearby buildings.

pplant-waste.label: Waste-to-energy plant
pplant-waste.description: Burning waste supplies heat to produce steam. That steam can generate electricity or deliver heat to nearby buildings.

solarplant.label: Solar generation
solarplant.description: Solar generation converts sunlight into electricity. Rooftop arrays and utility plants differ in scale but use the same resource.

pplant-solar.label: Solar generation
pplant-solar.description: Solar generation converts sunlight into electricity. Rooftop arrays and utility plants differ in scale but use the same resource.

windplant.label: Wind generation
windplant.description: Wind turns the rotors of turbines connected to generators. Several turbines can supply a shared electrical connection.

pplant-wind.label: Wind generation
pplant-wind.description: Wind turns the rotors of turbines connected to generators. Several turbines can supply a shared electrical connection.

biomassplant.label: Biomass generation
biomassplant.description: Biological material supplies fuel or gas for energy production. The feedstock and conversion process vary between facilities.

pplant-biomass.label: Biomass generation
pplant-biomass.description: Biological material supplies fuel or gas for energy production. The feedstock and conversion process vary between facilities.

batteryplant.label: Battery energy storage
batteryplant.description: A battery system stores electricity and releases it later. Storage shifts energy in time rather than producing fuel or sunlight.

pplant-battery.label: Battery energy storage
pplant-battery.description: A battery system stores electricity and releases it later. Storage shifts energy in time rather than producing fuel or sunlight.

sub.label: Electrical substation
sub.description: A substation switches circuits, changes voltage or performs both jobs. Transformers and protective equipment connect parts of the electric grid.

substation.label: Electrical substation
substation.description: A substation switches circuits, changes voltage or performs both jobs. Transformers and protective equipment connect parts of the electric grid.

transmission.label: Electric transmission
transmission.description: Transmission lines carry electricity over longer distances between generators, substations and large demand centers. Their high voltage reduces current for a given amount of power.

power.label: Electric transmission
power.description: Transmission lines carry electricity over longer distances between generators, substations and large demand centers. Their high voltage reduces current for a given amount of power.

distribution.label: Electric distribution
distribution.description: Distribution circuits carry electricity from substations toward customers. Local transformers reduce the voltage for buildings and equipment.

powerminor.label: Electric distribution
powerminor.description: Distribution circuits carry electricity from substations toward customers. Local transformers reduce the voltage for buildings and equipment.

transformer.label: Transformer
transformer.description: A transformer uses electromagnetic induction to change alternating-current voltage. It does not change the frequency of the power.

cogeneration.label: Combined heat and power
cogeneration.description: One energy process supplies both useful heat and electricity. A heating network can deliver the recovered heat to nearby buildings.

ww.label: Drinking-water treatment plant
ww.description: A drinking-water plant removes contaminants and prepares water for distribution. Its processes depend on the source water and the utility.

waterworks.label: Drinking-water treatment plant
waterworks.description: A drinking-water plant removes contaminants and prepares water for distribution. Its processes depend on the source water and the utility.

watermain.label: Water main
watermain.description: A water main is part of the pressurized network that distributes drinking water. Smaller service connections take water from the main into individual properties.

watermains.label: Water main
watermains.description: A water main is part of the pressurized network that distributes drinking water. Smaller service connections take water from the main into individual properties.

waterSupply.label: Water main
waterSupply.description: A water main is part of the pressurized network that distributes drinking water. Smaller service connections take water from the main into individual properties.

waterSupplyNetwork.label: Water main
waterSupplyNetwork.description: A water main is part of the pressurized network that distributes drinking water. Smaller service connections take water from the main into individual properties.

tower.label: Water tower
tower.description: An elevated tank stores water above the surrounding network. Its height supplies pressure, while stored water helps balance changes in demand. Historic towers can remain standing after water storage ends.

watertower.label: Water tower
watertower.description: An elevated tank stores water above the surrounding network. Its height supplies pressure, while stored water helps balance changes in demand. Historic towers can remain standing after water storage ends.

hydrant.label: Fire hydrant
hydrant.description: A hydrant gives firefighters a connection to the water network. Its position does not show the exact route or size of the buried water main.

waterService.label: Water service line
waterService.description: A service line connects a property to the drinking-water main. A material inventory may describe the public and private portions separately.

waterservice.label: Water service line
waterservice.description: A service line connects a property to the drinking-water main. A material inventory may describe the public and private portions separately.

serviceline.label: Water service line
serviceline.description: A service line connects a property to the drinking-water main. A material inventory may describe the public and private portions separately.

service.label: Water service line
service.description: A service line connects a property to the drinking-water main. A material inventory may describe the public and private portions separately.

waterService-lead.label: Lead service line
waterService-lead.description: A lead service line is a drinking-water connection made partly or entirely of lead. The inventory describes a recorded material, not a water sample or a complete plumbing inspection.

leadservice.label: Lead service line
leadservice.description: A lead service line is a drinking-water connection made partly or entirely of lead. The inventory describes a recorded material, not a water sample or a complete plumbing inspection.

waterService-galvanized.label: Galvanized service pipe
waterService-galvanized.description: Galvanized steel pipe has a protective zinc coating. An inventory can distinguish the material from the separate question of whether replacement is required.

galvanizedservice.label: Galvanized service pipe
galvanizedservice.description: Galvanized steel pipe has a protective zinc coating. An inventory can distinguish the material from the separate question of whether replacement is required.

waterService-copper.label: Copper service pipe
waterService-copper.description: Copper tubing can connect a property to the drinking-water main. The recorded service material does not describe every pipe and fitting inside the building.

copperservice.label: Copper service pipe
copperservice.description: Copper tubing can connect a property to the drinking-water main. The recorded service material does not describe every pipe and fitting inside the building.

waterService-plastic.label: Plastic service pipe
waterService-plastic.description: Plastic pipe can form a drinking-water service connection. The material category may include different polymers and does not by itself identify the exact product.

plasticservice.label: Plastic service pipe
plasticservice.description: Plastic pipe can form a drinking-water service connection. The material category may include different polymers and does not by itself identify the exact product.

waterService-unknown.label: Unknown service material
waterService-unknown.description: Unknown means that the published inventory does not establish the service material. It does not mean that the line is made of lead.

unknownservice.label: Unknown service material
unknownservice.description: Unknown means that the published inventory does not establish the service material. It does not mean that the line is made of lead.

ductileIron.label: Ductile iron pipe
ductileIron.description: Ductile iron pipe carries pressurized water in many distribution networks. Pipe material and age alone do not establish its present condition.

pressure.label: Pressure regulator
pressure.description: A regulator controls pressure downstream of a valve. Water utilities use pressure control to serve areas at different elevations or operating pressures.

watermeter.label: Water meter
watermeter.description: A water meter measures water supplied to a property or a part of the network. It supports billing, demand measurement or leakage investigation.

tplant.label: Wastewater treatment plant
tplant.description: A wastewater plant removes pollutants before water returns to the environment. Screens, settling tanks and biological treatment perform different parts of that work.

wastewaterplant.label: Wastewater treatment plant
wastewaterplant.description: A wastewater plant removes pollutants before water returns to the environment. Screens, settling tanks and biological treatment perform different parts of that work.

tplantGhost.label: Former wastewater treatment site
tplantGhost.description: This record marks a former treatment site. A historical point does not establish that its old buildings, tanks or pipes remain in place.

san.label: Sanitary sewer
san.description: A sanitary sewer carries wastewater from buildings toward treatment. It is intended for sewage rather than runoff from streets and roofs.

sanitary.label: Sanitary sewer
sanitary.description: A sanitary sewer carries wastewater from buildings toward treatment. It is intended for sewage rather than runoff from streets and roofs.

sanitarysewer.label: Sanitary sewer
sanitarysewer.description: A sanitary sewer carries wastewater from buildings toward treatment. It is intended for sewage rather than runoff from streets and roofs.

interceptor.label: Interceptor sewer
interceptor.description: An interceptor collects flow from smaller sewers and carries it toward a treatment plant. It forms part of the regional wastewater network.

gravity.label: Gravity sewer
gravity.description: A gravity sewer carries wastewater downhill without a pump along that segment. Its slope and elevation connect it to the surrounding network.

gravitysewer.label: Gravity sewer
gravitysewer.description: A gravity sewer carries wastewater downhill without a pump along that segment. Its slope and elevation connect it to the surrounding network.

forcemain.label: Sewer force main
forcemain.description: A force main carries wastewater under pressure from a pumping station. Pressure lets it cross terrain that a continuously descending gravity pipe cannot follow.

forceMain.label: Sewer force main
forceMain.description: A force main carries wastewater under pressure from a pumping station. Pressure lets it cross terrain that a continuously descending gravity pipe cannot follow.

siphon.label: Inverted sewer siphon
siphon.description: An inverted siphon dips beneath an obstacle and then rises again. The closed pipe flows full under pressure from the difference in water level between its ends.

invertedSiphon.label: Inverted sewer siphon
invertedSiphon.description: An inverted siphon dips beneath an obstacle and then rises again. The closed pipe flows full under pressure from the difference in water level between its ends.

lift.label: Wastewater pumping station
lift.description: A wastewater pumping station lifts flow to a higher elevation. The connected force main carries that pressurized flow onward.

sewagepump.label: Wastewater pumping station
sewagepump.description: A wastewater pumping station lifts flow to a higher elevation. The connected force main carries that pressurized flow onward.

pumping.label: Wastewater pumping station
pumping.description: A wastewater pumping station lifts flow to a higher elevation. The connected force main carries that pressurized flow onward.

meter.label: Sewer flow meter
meter.description: A sewer flow meter measures flow through part of the wastewater network. The measurement can help operators account for contributions and investigate changes in flow.

flowmeter.label: Sewer flow meter
flowmeter.description: A sewer flow meter measures flow through part of the wastewater network. The measurement can help operators account for contributions and investigate changes in flow.

combinedsewer.label: Combined sewer
combinedsewer.description: A combined sewer carries sewage and stormwater in the same pipe. Heavy rain can exceed the capacity of a combined system.

manhole.label: Manhole
manhole.description: A manhole provides access to buried infrastructure for inspection and maintenance. Its surface cover does not reveal every connected pipe.

storm.label: Storm sewer
storm.description: A storm sewer carries runoff from streets, roofs and other surfaces. It belongs to a drainage network whose outlets and treatment differ from those of a sanitary sewer.

stormmain.label: Storm sewer
stormmain.description: A storm sewer carries runoff from streets, roofs and other surfaces. It belongs to a drainage network whose outlets and treatment differ from those of a sanitary sewer.

stormsewer.label: Storm sewer
stormsewer.description: A storm sewer carries runoff from streets, roofs and other surfaces. It belongs to a drainage network whose outlets and treatment differ from those of a sanitary sewer.

inlet.label: Storm drain inlet
inlet.description: An inlet admits surface runoff into the drainage system. A catch basin can also collect sediment below the outlet pipe.

catchbasin.label: Storm drain inlet
catchbasin.description: An inlet admits surface runoff into the drainage system. A catch basin can also collect sediment below the outlet pipe.

storminlet.label: Storm drain inlet
storminlet.description: An inlet admits surface runoff into the drainage system. A catch basin can also collect sediment below the outlet pipe.

culvert.label: Culvert
culvert.description: A culvert carries water beneath a road, railway or other obstruction. Its opening can be a round pipe, a box or another enclosed channel.

bstream.label: Buried creek
bstream.description: A buried creek follows a channel or conduit below the surface. Historical mapped reaches can document a former watercourse without locating every surviving pipe.

buriedstream.label: Buried creek
buriedstream.description: A buried creek follows a channel or conduit below the surface. Historical mapped reaches can document a former watercourse without locating every surviving pipe.

buriedcreek.label: Buried creek
buriedcreek.description: A buried creek follows a channel or conduit below the surface. Historical mapped reaches can document a former watercourse without locating every surviving pipe.

aqueduct.label: Aqueduct
aqueduct.description: An aqueduct conveys water between places. The word can describe a channel, tunnel, pipeline or bridge that carries part of a water-supply route.

watershed.label: Drainage basin
watershed.description: A drainage basin is the area contributing water to a common outlet. Land use and surface cover affect the water that reaches that outlet.

sewershed.label: Sewer service area
sewershed.description: A sewer service area follows the collection network that sends wastewater toward a common treatment facility. It need not share the boundaries of a natural watershed.

well.label: Well
well.description: A well reaches groundwater through a drilled or dug opening. The mapped record does not by itself establish whether the well is active or suitable for drinking.

aquifer.label: Aquifer
aquifer.description: An aquifer is a geologic material that can store and transmit groundwater. Its usefulness depends on permeability, water quality and the available supply.

gas.label: Pipeline
gas.description: A pipeline transports a fluid between places. The dataset identifies the recorded substance or operator where available, rather than every local service connection.

pipeline.label: Pipeline
pipeline.description: A pipeline transports a fluid between places. The dataset identifies the recorded substance or operator where available, rather than every local service connection.

pipes.label: Pipeline
pipes.description: A pipeline transports a fluid between places. The dataset identifies the recorded substance or operator where available, rather than every local service connection.

pipestation.label: Compressor station
pipestation.description: A gas compressor station adds pressure so gas can continue through a pipeline. The mapped station does not describe the layout of its individual machines.

compressorstation.label: Compressor station
compressorstation.description: A gas compressor station adds pressure so gas can continue through a pipeline. The mapped station does not describe the layout of its individual machines.

dc.label: Data center
dc.description: A data center houses computing and networking equipment with supporting power and cooling systems. The building may serve one organization or host several customers.

datacenter.label: Data center
datacenter.description: A data center houses computing and networking equipment with supporting power and cooling systems. The building may serve one organization or host several customers.

carrierhotel.label: Carrier hotel
carrierhotel.description: A carrier hotel houses equipment from multiple network operators. Operators can connect their networks inside the same building.

carrier.label: Carrier hotel
carrier.description: A carrier hotel houses equipment from multiple network operators. Operators can connect their networks inside the same building.

exch.label: Telephone exchange
exch.description: A telephone exchange connects calls within and between telephone networks. A historical exchange building can have a different use today.

telephoneexchange.label: Telephone exchange
telephoneexchange.description: A telephone exchange connects calls within and between telephone networks. A historical exchange building can have a different use today.

internetExchange.label: Internet exchange point
internetExchange.description: An internet exchange lets participating networks exchange traffic directly. The exchange is a network service that can occupy space in one or more facilities.

ixp.label: Internet exchange point
ixp.description: An internet exchange lets participating networks exchange traffic directly. The exchange is a network service that can occupy space in one or more facilities.

fiber.label: Fiber optic communication
fiber.description: Optical fiber carries data as pulses of light. A mapped network connection does not establish the route of every buried cable.

fibre.label: Fiber optic communication
fibre.description: Optical fiber carries data as pulses of light. A mapped network connection does not establish the route of every buried cable.

utilitytunnel.label: Utility tunnel
utilitytunnel.description: A utility tunnel gives workers an accessible passage containing pipes, cables or both. It differs from a buried pipe that can only be reached by excavation or through access structures.

tunnel.label: Utility tunnel
tunnel.description: A utility tunnel gives workers an accessible passage containing pipes, cables or both. It differs from a buried pipe that can only be reached by excavation or through access structures.

districtheat.label: District heating
districtheat.description: A central plant supplies heat to several buildings through a network of pipes. The circulating fluid can be hot water or steam.

districtHeating.label: District heating
districtHeating.description: A central plant supplies heat to several buildings through a network of pipes. The circulating fluid can be hot water or steam.

districtcool.label: District cooling
districtcool.description: A central plant supplies chilled water to several buildings. A return pipe brings water back after it absorbs heat.

dam.label: Dam
dam.description: A dam holds back or controls flowing water. It can supply a water-level difference for power, navigation, storage or another purpose.

lock.label: Navigation lock
lock.description: A lock raises or lowers vessels between water levels. Gates and valves control water in the chamber while a vessel passes through.

cutoffwall.label: Buried cutoff wall
cutoffwall.description: A cutoff wall blocks or reduces water movement through the ground. At Saint Anthony Falls, the historic wall protects the material beneath the limestone ledge; it is not visible from the surface.
cutoffwall.referenceNote: The Wikipedia article for Cutoff wall redirects to modern slurry-wall construction. This link instead describes the historic Saint Anthony Falls structure.

road.label: Road
road.description: A road carries movement along a prepared surface. The line here provides street context; it does not identify the route of utilities beneath the pavement.

roads.label: Road
roads.description: A road carries movement along a prepared surface. The line here provides street context; it does not identify the route of utilities beneath the pavement.

street.label: Road
street.description: A road carries movement along a prepared surface. The line here provides street context; it does not identify the route of utilities beneath the pavement.

water.label: River
water.description: A river carries surface water through a channel. A mapped river reach is surface-water context, separate from a drinking-water distribution main.

river.label: River
river.description: A river carries surface water through a channel. A mapped river reach is surface-water context, separate from a drinking-water distribution main.

surfacewater.label: River
surfacewater.description: A river carries surface water through a channel. A mapped river reach is surface-water context, separate from a drinking-water distribution main.

groundwater.label: Groundwater contamination area
groundwater.description: This polygon records an area of known or investigated groundwater contamination. Its source record and current program status explain what was mapped; it is not a test of water at every point inside it.

groundwaterSource.label: Groundwater contamination source area
groundwaterSource.description: A source area identifies the mapped location associated with a contamination source. It differs from the larger area through which affected groundwater may move.

groundwaterBoundary.label: Groundwater area boundary
groundwaterBoundary.description: This line records an interpreted boundary and its stated certainty. It outlines an environmental investigation area rather than a fault in the rock.

groundwaterSite.label: Groundwater investigation site
groundwaterSite.description: This point identifies a site associated with groundwater investigation or cleanup. The source record describes the program and status; the point does not outline the full affected area.

cleanup.label: Cleanup program site
cleanup.description: A cleanup record identifies a site and the environmental program associated with it. Program listings can include investigation, active work and closed cases, so a point alone does not establish current contamination.

remediation.label: Cleanup program site
remediation.description: A cleanup record identifies a site and the environmental program associated with it. Program listings can include investigation, active work and closed cases, so a point alone does not establish current contamination.

undergroundtank.label: Underground storage tank
undergroundtank.description: An underground storage tank holds a substance below ground. A tanks-program record can identify a site without locating each tank or establishing whether a release occurred.

tank.label: Underground storage tank
tank.description: An underground storage tank holds a substance below ground. A tanks-program record can identify a site without locating each tank or establishing whether a release occurred.

borehole.label: Borehole
borehole.description: A borehole is a drilled opening used for water, sampling, observation or another purpose. Its record describes the opening rather than a complete area beneath the surface.

wspSanManhole.label: Manhole
wspSanManhole.description: A manhole provides access to a sewer or drain for inspection and maintenance. The published system identifies whether this structure belongs to the sanitary or storm network.

wspStormManhole.label: Manhole
wspStormManhole.description: A manhole provides access to a sewer or drain for inspection and maintenance. The published system identifies whether this structure belongs to the sanitary or storm network.

wspInlets.label: Storm drain inlet
wspInlets.description: An inlet admits surface runoff into the drainage network. The published storm system describes its location and recorded structure type.

pave.label: Pavement condition
pave.description: A pavement condition index summarizes surveyed surface distress. It describes the road surface rather than the condition of the utilities underneath it.

pavement.label: Pavement condition
pavement.description: A pavement condition index summarizes surveyed surface distress. It describes the road surface rather than the condition of the utilities underneath it.

bdepth.label: Depth to bedrock
bdepth.description: Depth to bedrock is the distance from the ground surface to solid rock beneath soil and unconsolidated deposits. A model estimates that surface between observations.

bedrockdepth.label: Depth to bedrock
bedrockdepth.description: Depth to bedrock is the distance from the ground surface to solid rock beneath soil and unconsolidated deposits. A model estimates that surface between observations.

bedrock.label: Bedrock geology
bedrock.description: Bedrock is the solid rock beneath soil and loose sediment. A geologic map groups rock by its age, material and stratigraphic relationships.

fault.label: Geologic fault
fault.description: A fault is a fracture along which rock has moved. A mapped trace records the interpreted position of that structure.

bfault.label: Geologic fault
bfault.description: A fault is a fracture along which rock has moved. A mapped trace records the interpreted position of that structure.

bedrock-Cmu.label: Middle and Upper Cambrian rocks
bedrock-Cmu.description: This map group includes sandstone, siltstone and shale assigned to the middle and upper Cambrian. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

bedrock-Cu.label: Upper Cambrian rocks
bedrock-Cu.description: This map group includes sandstone, siltstone, shale and dolostone assigned to the upper Cambrian. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

bedrock-Ol.label: Lower Ordovician rocks
bedrock-Ol.description: This map group includes dolostone and sandstone assigned to the lower Ordovician. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

bedrock-Omu.label: Middle and Upper Ordovician rocks
bedrock-Omu.description: This map group includes shale, limestone and sandstone assigned to the middle and upper Ordovician. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

bedrock-Ou.label: Upper Ordovician rocks
bedrock-Ou.description: This map group includes limestone and dolostone assigned to the upper Ordovician. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

bedrock-window.label: Bedrock erosional window
bedrock-window.description: An erosional window exposes an older rock unit through a younger one. This map label does not identify a single formation.

stpeter.label: Saint Peter Sandstone
stpeter.description: Saint Peter Sandstone is an Ordovician sandstone formation. Its porous and erodible rock is part of the geologic setting beneath the Twin Cities.

platteville.label: Platteville Limestone
platteville.description: Platteville limestone overlies softer formations in parts of the Twin Cities. This named formation is more specific than the broad groups in the regional bedrock layer.

jordan.label: Jordan Sandstone
jordan.description: Jordan Sandstone is an upper Cambrian sandstone formation. Its water-bearing rock is part of a regional groundwater system.

decorah.label: Decorah Shale
decorah.description: Decorah Shale is an Ordovician formation dominated by shale. It is a named formation rather than one of the broad age groups displayed in the regional map.

glenwood.label: Glenwood Formation
glenwood.description: The Glenwood Formation is an Ordovician unit between Saint Peter Sandstone and Platteville rocks in this region. The broad map groups do not locate it separately.

bedrock-Osp.label: Saint Peter Sandstone
bedrock-Osp.description: Saint Peter Sandstone is an Ordovician sandstone formation. Its porous and erodible rock is part of the geologic setting beneath the Twin Cities.

bedrock-Opg.label: Platteville and Glenwood formations
bedrock-Opg.description: This grouped unit contains Platteville and Glenwood rocks. Its code identifies both formations, so it must not be described as Platteville alone.

Cmu.label: Middle and Upper Cambrian rocks
Cmu.description: This map group includes sandstone, siltstone and shale assigned to the middle and upper Cambrian. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

Cu.label: Upper Cambrian rocks
Cu.description: This map group includes sandstone, siltstone, shale and dolostone assigned to the upper Cambrian. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

Ol.label: Lower Ordovician rocks
Ol.description: This map group includes dolostone and sandstone assigned to the lower Ordovician. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

Omu.label: Middle and Upper Ordovician rocks
Omu.description: This map group includes shale, limestone and sandstone assigned to the middle and upper Ordovician. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

Ou.label: Upper Ordovician rocks
Ou.description: This map group includes limestone and dolostone assigned to the upper Ordovician. It is a grouped map unit, not a single named formation.

Osp.label: Saint Peter Sandstone
Osp.description: Saint Peter Sandstone is an Ordovician sandstone formation. Its porous and erodible rock is part of the geologic setting beneath the Twin Cities.

Opg.label: Platteville and Glenwood formations
Opg.description: This grouped unit contains Platteville and Glenwood rocks. Its code identifies both formations, so it must not be described as Platteville alone.
